variables.label: Rainfall
variables.reason: Rainfall data is crucial to determine if precipitation levels have decreased over time in the area.

variables.label: Temperature
variables.reason: Temperature trends help assess potential increases in evaporation rates that could cause drying conditions.

variables.label: Very hot days
variables.reason: Tracking very hot days helps evaluate extreme heat stress contributing to water loss and drought.

variables.label: Root-zone soil moisture
variables.reason: Root-zone soil moisture reveals the actual underground water availability for vegetation and the ecosystem.

variables.label: Vegetation (NDVI)
variables.reason: Vegetation index indicates plant health and whether greenness is declining due to water scarcity.
